1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than __2000 Da__ and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than __200__ nm.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a __multivalent metal cation__ crosslinker.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is __polyethylenimine or a derivative thereof__.

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and __other anionic polymers__.

5) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent metal cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate.

6) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions, wherein said cations are present in a concentration sufficient to enhance the stability of the nanoparticle.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex comprises a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about __100 to 200 nm__ in diameter.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a __multivalent metal cation__.

13) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent metal cation comprising __zirconium, chromium, titanium, iron or aluminum__.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer that can be crosslinked with a); and c) a fluid.

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, or __other suitable polymers__. 

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where fluid is __selected from the group consisting of brine, seawater, or other aqueous solutions__.
